payload.summary: post-cycle.md Step 4.5's documented call `log_agent_work(tag="sprint-boundary", state=current_sprint_id)` does not match the live MCP tool schema for log_agent_work — the tool requires `agent_name` (string) + `status` (enum running|completed|error), and `completed`/`error` additionally require the `id` returned by a prior `status="running"` call. There is no `tag` or `state` parameter on the live tool at all. A literal reading of the doc text would fail every call with an InputValidationError.
payload.found_during: Step 4.5 Compact Checkpoint, tick 2026-07-30T16:37Z — attempted the documented call verbatim, got a Zod validation error naming agent_name/status as required; called mcp__gateway__list_server_tools(server="vn-market") to confirm the real schema, then used the correct running->completed two-call lifecycle with the returned id instead
